name: Canisar
traitsHtml:
Darkvision.

You have Darkvision with a range of 120 ft.

Hind Leg Dash.

You gain an additional 10 ft of movement speed until the end of your turn whenever you use the Dash or Disengage action.

Fanged Jaws.

If you hit a target with an Unarmed Strike|XPHB, you can deal piercing damage equal to 1d4 plus your Strength modifier.

Hunter Gatherer.

You have proficiency in the Nature, Survival or Stealth skill.

Ancestral Blessing.

Once per Short Rest|XPHB, you can cast the Guidance spell on yourself as an Action|XPHB.

name: Hederan
traitsHtml:
Darkvision.

You have Darkvision with a range of 60 ft.

Outdoor Adept.

You can move across Difficult Terrain|XPHB made from earth or foliage without expending extra movement.

Protected by Nature.

You can attempt to Hide even when you are only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain/snow, mist, or other natural phenomena.

Friend of Fauna.

Once per Long Rest|XPHB, you can cast the Beast Bond spell without the material components needed and without expending a spell slot.

name: Snowborn
traitsHtml:
Chilled Anatomy.

You have Resistance|XPHB to Cold damage. You also know the Ray of Frost cantrip.

Compacted Snow.

You can move through the space of any creature that is a size larger than you, but you can't stop in the same space. Additionally, you can squeeze through a space that is large enough for a creature one size smaller than you without movement penalties.

Frigid Construct.

You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest|XPHB in 4 hours if you spend those hours unmoving; during this time you are indistinguishable from a snowman, but retain consciousness. You don't need to eat, drink or breathe.

Glacial Form.

Once per long rest, you can cast the False Life spell without using the material components or expending a spell slot, and harden your body into ice.

name: Tarandus
traitsHtml:
Guiding Light.

As a Bonus Action|XPHB, you can produce dim light in a 20 ft radius from your nose. You can end this effect as a Bonus Action|XPHB.

Antler Defence.

Once per Short Rest|XPHB as a Reaction|XPHB, you can lower your antlers and enter a defensive stance. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +2 bonus to your Armor Class|XPHB against melee attacks.

Hooves.

If you hit a target with an Unarmed Strike|XPHB, you can deal bludgeoning damage equal to 1d4 plus your Strength modifier.

Born to Navigate.

You have proficiency in the Perception or Survival skill.
